title: Radius of starlikeness of $\mathcal{S}\ast \mathcal {S}t(α)$
summary: Let $\mathcal{S}$ be the set of all analytic univalent functions $f$ defined in the open unit disc $\mathbb{D}$, with $f(0)=0=f'(0)-1$. For $α\in[0,1)$, let $\mathcal{S}t(α)$ be the set of all starlike functions of order $α$ in $\mathcal{S}$. In this article, by applying duality technique we obtain the radius of a disc that is mapped onto a starlike domain with respect to the origin by the functions in the set $\mathcal{S}\ast \mathcal {S}t(α):=\{f\ast g :f\in\mathcal{S},~g\in\mathcal{S}t(α)\}$.
